sonnet.problem: Two wrong answers, 'Stern but fair' and 'Strict and demanding', mean almost the same thing as each other. Both describe an exacting God, so they work as look-alikes.
sonnet.rule: Two wrong answers never mean the same as each other either.

sonnet.problem: The right answer, 'Delivered him from the depths of Sheol', is the only one in Bible phrasing. The wrong answers are plain modern phrasing, so the right one stands out.
sonnet.rule: Don't let the right answer stand out. All the answers should sound alike. None should sound more like the Bible, or more modern, than the others.

sonnet.problem: This story card retells verse 3 ('All day long'), the very fact the previous true/false card just asked and revealed. Only verse 4 is new, so the card works as a recap.
